plan.title: Experience capture: per model/agent/role/version tracking with recency+version weighting
plan.goal: MVP: baseline snapshot (aq-baseline) with before/after comparison and metric-trust rules over existing producers for learning loops, feature activations and improvement cycles. Phase 2 (capture, join, adjudication, cards) is gated by entry criteria in DESIGN.md.
success_criteria: Each snapshot reproducible from retained digest-addressed input copies (J0)
Compare bound to a feature or cycle effective start, with rejection cases (J0b, J0c)
Independent units (PR) with n>=20 floor; unknowns and in-flight shown

decisions.decision: no_baseline = WARN on every commit, HARD only in scheduled maintenance
Drop rework/cycle-time/useful_ratio on 2027-02-25 if below minimum sample or without denominator
No Phase 2 until S-M1 has run 30 days and entry criteria are met

phases.name: Freeze
phases.goal: Frozen rev5 PRD (PLAN_READY_WITH_FOLLOWUPS) and owner decisions 1-4

phases.name: Baseline (MVP)
phases.goal: aq-baseline snapshot/verify/compare plus aq-qa and pm-tracker checks

phases.name: Phase 2 (gated)
phases.goal: Capture, join, adjudication, cards; starts only after entry criteria

phases.name: Post-Phase-2
phases.goal: Wrappers, priors, rollup, alerts, exploration, ranking, routing

items.name: Freeze rev5 PRD and owner decisions
items.goal: Rev5 frozen 2026-11-26 by owner hyperd as PLAN_READY_WITH_FOLLOWUPS (override after 5 Codex rounds, reviewed sha 1869c40c3); owner decisions 1-4 decided 2026-11-25.
items.validation_goal: Freeze record in DESIGN.md header with reviewed sha 1869c40c3.

items.name: Baseline snapshot and metric-trust checks
items.goal: aq-baseline snapshot/verify/compare with snapshot_id, captured_at, pinned input window and source rev; aq-qa CheckResult; aq-pm-tracker no_baseline WARN; trust rules (full population primary, concentration as sensitivity); digest-addressed input copies; live age/verify indicator; rollback stops the schedule first..
items.validation_goal: J0 live capture and verify from retained inputs; J0b feature and J0c cycle bound compare with rejection cases; live indicator in aq-qa/aq-report.
acceptance: AT-1 compare binding and rejection cases
AT-2 aggregate unit type with observation membership
AT-3 mint-failure count reported as gap no_producer until aq-land emits structured failure events
AT-4 live age/verify display and decision-2 WARN/HARD exercised
AT-5 naming and freeze record aligned to rev5

items.name: Capture lib, sanitizer, codex+gemini wrappers
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] experience_emit over make_event; spool/flock/0600/token-redaction fixes; prompt-safe sanitizer and gitignore; model/quota fields (quota emission conditional on a real fallback); codex and gemini foreground+background wrappers and quota fallback emit. Depends on a dated baseline snapshot existing before merge.
items.validation_goal: Real dispatches on two lanes give complete prompt_load+model_call; secret quarantined hash-only (J1, J7).

items.name: Join review receipt, author and reviewer outcomes
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] review event; D5/D5b outcomes; author_run_ids[]/reviewed_run_ids[]; redo/revert links; idempotent event_id and supersession; aq-land plumbing.
items.validation_goal: Real landing yields full chain; repeated same-head review collapses to one outcome plus waste (J2, J4).

items.name: Cards, efficiency metric, report/dashboard/QA/hints
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] experience_cards.py, experience-weighting.json, one is_learning_eligible, aq-report section, dashboard route+card, aq-qa CheckResult, advisory hint, trustworthy efficiency metric. Ranking deferred (EC-P8).
items.validation_goal: Hand recomputation to 3 decimals; unknown outcome leaves S unchanged; live report (J3, J5, J6).

items.name: Wire claude, local and fanout wrappers
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] Remaining delegate wrappers emit with dispatch_id==run_id.
items.validation_goal: Real dispatches on each lane give J1 chain.

items.name: Version priors and release-note intake
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] Version-change detector, sourced version_priors, carry-over prior, stale-assumption flag.
items.validation_goal: Real or replayed version change yields a sourced prior-driven cell (J8).

items.name: Rollup and retention
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] Daily rollup with sufficient statistics and quantile buckets, immutable cutover, verified compression of raw events over 90 days.
items.validation_goal: Rollup totals equal raw totals for a real month; size drop measured; restore test.

items.name: Divergence alerts, replay, per-instance cards
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] Divergence alert job, aq-prompt-eval --replay, instance cards at n>=10.
items.validation_goal: Replay on two lanes writes comparable rows; alert or honest none.

items.name: Experiment engine with bounded exploration
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] experiments.jsonl, atomic slot reservation, epsilon-greedy selector, promotion, setting_change with revert. Not started until owner decision on a non-empty eligible list (Rule 23).
items.validation_goal: Bounded experiment, gate task refused, revert verified (J9, J10).

items.name: Calibrated ranking
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] Introduce a rank value only after an interval is calibrated for the scoring unit (distinct reviewed work item) on real data; then the advisory ranked hint.
items.validation_goal: Coverage check on real or replayed data shows nominal coverage; ranking used only if it passes.

items.name: Routing weights and automatic promotion
items.goal: [Phase 2/3, entry criteria in DESIGN.md] Optional enforcement after 30 days of data and independent review.
